summary: Architecture/design phase only -- no introspection implementation, CLI command, REST endpoint, web UI, or execution capability introduced; no file under src/pcae/ touched. Designs how PCAE exposes Runtime, Registry, Plugin, Capability, Session, and Health information through a safe, read-only introspection model. First phase of the 111-series. Restates the core principle -- Runtime orchestrates, Registry resolves, Plugins implement, Metadata precedes behavior -- and extends it with this phase's own addition, Visibility precedes authority: no future authorization/approval/execution-capability phase may skip past a frozen introspection layer. Defines Runtime Introspection as the Runtime's read-only visibility layer -- exposes information, never changes behavior -- generalizing three existing narrow precedents (pcae health, pcae governance audit, RuntimeRegistry.registry_health()/.validate_consistency(), 110E/110F), none modified by this phase. Freezes fifteen canonical introspection domains: Runtime, Registry, Plugins, Capabilities, Policy, Observation, Session, Task, Phase, Identity, Configuration, Health, Version, Governance, Future Execution -- seven already have a real, working, read-only precedent today; Future Execution is named permanently the least-visible domain. Freezes a four-tier visibility model: Visible, Hidden, Requires future authorization, Permanently unavailable. Freezes eleven introspection objects, design only: RuntimeInfo, RegistryInfo, PluginInfo, CapabilityInfo, HealthInfo, VersionInfo, GovernanceInfo, RuntimeStateInfo, SessionInfo, TaskInfo, PhaseInfo -- RegistryInfo/PluginInfo map directly onto 110E/110F's RegistrySnapshot/PluginDescriptor; SessionInfo/TaskInfo/PhaseInfo map onto existing pcae session/task/phase JSON output. Freezes an eight-facet Runtime Health Model; current expected aggregate state, without exception, Healthy/Execution unavailable. Freezes the Runtime Status Model as a verbatim restatement of 110A section 8's eight-state model, deliberately not a new vocabulary; current state, without exception, Observed. Freezes an eight-operation Introspection API, design only: GetRuntime(), GetRegistry(), GetPlugins(), GetCapabilities(), GetHealth(), GetGovernance(), GetState(), GetVersion(). Freezes visibility rules: may expose metadata/contracts/health/status/capabilities/version/compatibility; must never expose execution handles/plugin instances/internal mutable state/secret material/credentials/approval bypasses/execution control. Added docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_INTROSPECTION.md, docs/PHASE_111_RUNTIME_INTROSPECTION_ARCHITECTURE.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change, matching 110C's/110D's/110E's/110F's own evaluation outcome. 164 new tests (tests/test_runtime_introspection_architecture.py), a pure documentation-verification suite. Focused tests (935), governance/autonomy group (1991), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).
